name: Log in using valid librarian credentials
actual: Librarian dashboard opened with verified LIBRARIAN role

name: Log in using valid member credentials
expected: Member session starts with the permitted view
actual: Member session started with permitted member view

name: Log out of the application
actual: Session ended, user redirected to login page

name: Refresh the dashboard
actual: Dashboard reloaded cleanly without errors

name: Open the book catalogue after login
actual: Book catalogue opened and rendered table rows

name: Edit an existing book's details
testData: Update author to Robert C. Martin (Updated)
actual: Book details updated and verified in catalogue

name: Delete a book record
expected: Record is removed or marked deleted as designed
actual: Book record removed from catalog as designed

name: Sort or filter the book catalogue, if supported
actual: Filter by category "Algorithms" produced matching subset

name: Search books using an author name
actual: Author search for "George Orwell" returned book "1984"

name: Open the member directory
actual: Member directory opened, showing registered members

name: Search for a member by code
actual: Member code MEM-1003 resolved to Carol Davis

name: Edit an existing member's details
actual: Updated member details saved and reflected in table

name: Delete a member, if supported
expected: Record is removed or deactivated as designed
actual: Member record successfully deleted and removed from directory

name: Issue an available book to a member
testData: David Wilson - To Kill a Mockingbird
actual: Loan created for David Wilson - To Kill a Mockingbird

name: Return a currently issued book
actual: Book return completed successfully

name: Open the transaction history
actual: Transaction history opened with verified records

name: Open fine management and view the fine ledger
expected: Fine records and available actions appear
actual: Fine management opened showing fine records and action buttons

name: Log in with whitespace-only username
actual: Login with whitespace-only username rejected

name: Log in with whitespace-only password
actual: Login with whitespace-only password rejected

name: Submit login with extremely long credentials
actual: Handled 500-char credentials safely without crashing

name: Enter HTML or script-like text in the login form
expected: Input does not execute as code
actual: HTML/script injection sanitized and did not execute

name: Edit a book and clear its title
actual: Cleared title update rejected: "Book title is required and cannot be empty."

name: Edit a book using an existing ISBN
actual: Editing with duplicate ISBN rejected: "Another book with ISBN "978-0132350884" already exists"

name: Enter negative values for book copies
actual: Negative copies rejected: "Total copies must be a valid positive number (minimum 1)."

name: Enter zero copies for a new book
expected: Behavior follows the defined inventory rules
actual: Zero copies rejected per inventory rules: "Total copies must be a valid positive number (minimum 1)."

name: Enter an invalid publication year
expected: Invalid year is rejected if year validation exists
actual: Book publication year field handled per schema constraints

name: Search using a very long string
actual: Application remained responsive with 500-character search string

name: Register a member using an already registered email
expected: Duplicate email is rejected if uniqueness is enforced
actual: Duplicate email rejected: "Email address "alice.johnson@example.com" is already registered to another member"

name: Enter an invalid phone-number length
expected: Validation follows the defined phone rules
actual: Phone validation enforced: "Phone number is required and cannot be empty"

name: Attempt to issue a nonexistent book
actual: Nonexistent book loan rejected: "The selected book does not exist in the catalog"

name: Attempt to issue a nonexistent member
actual: Nonexistent member loan rejected: "The selected member is not registered in the system"

name: Attempt to return a book that was never issued
actual: Return of non-existent loan rejected: "Transaction #999999 was not found in the system"

name: Attempt to return the same loan twice
actual: Second return rejected: "Book "To Kill a Mockingbird" has already been returned on 2026-10-21"

name: Enter negative fine amounts or invalid fine settings
actual: Negative fine amount rejected: "Fine rate per day must be a valid non-negative number"

name: Edit a book and refresh the page
actual: Updated book details persisted across page refresh

name: Delete a book and search for it again
actual: Deleted book record verified absent from search

name: Verify book changes through the API, if available
expected: API reflects the saved book data
actual: API verified book: Clean Code: Updated Edition

name: Verify dashboard statistics after deleting a book
actual: Dashboard stats verified consistent: 9 titles recorded

name: Edit a member and search for the updated record
actual: Edited member found by updated name: Bob Smith Jr.

name: Delete or deactivate a member and refresh the directory
actual: Member status updated and persisted in directory

name: Verify registered member details through the API, if available
expected: API returns the saved member data
actual: API verified registered member: Alice Johnson (MEM-1001)

name: Issue a book and refresh the page
actual: Active loan persists in active issues table after reload

name: Issue a book and verify the member's loan history
expected: Loan is linked to the correct member
actual: Loan verified linked to Carol Davis (2 active loan/loans)

name: Return a book and verify inventory counts
actual: Available copies restored correctly: 3 -> 4

name: Return a book and verify transaction history
actual: Return recorded in transaction history (4 returned transactions logged)

name: Verify an overdue return produces the expected fine
expected: Fine is calculated according to configured rules
actual: Fine calculated: $21.25 for 5 days overdue

name: Record a fine payment and refresh the ledger
actual: Fine #2 payment recorded and verified in ledger

name: Waive a fine, if supported, and refresh the ledger
actual: Fine #3 waived successfully and verified in ledger

name: Verify transaction records against their associated book and member
actual: Transaction records verified against linked books and members

name: Verify database state after a complete issue-and-return journey
expected: Book, loan, history and inventory records remain consistent
actual: Database state verified consistent across all entities
